suppress.notes: CVE-2023-39022 affects opensymphony:oscore through 2.2.6. io.oryxos:oryxos-core is an unrelated first-party artifact that Dependency-Check matched only because its artifact name is similar to "oscore".

Spring Boot 3.5.16 pins Spring Framework 6.2.19. OSS fix requires Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Boot 4); 6.2.20 is enterprise-only per https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59313
CVE-2026-59313 / CVE-2026-59283 / CVE-2026-59314 affect SSE in Spring MVC functional web (RouterFunction, ServerResponse.sse). OryxOS uses conventional @RestController only; no matching usage in the codebase. Spring rates CVE-2026-59313 LOW.
Remove this suppression when upgrading to Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7.0.9+. See oryx-labs/oryxos#371.

CVE-2026-47892: WebFlux functional RouterFunction header-predicate bypass on CORS preflight when deployed via DispatcherServlet. OryxOS uses Spring MVC @RestController only (no WebFlux RouterFunction security predicates). Spring Framework 6.2.20 is the OSS fix line but not published to Maven Central for this Boot pin (enterprise-only for related 6.2.x advisories). Remove when Boot pins a fixed Framework.

Spring Boot 3.5.x pins Spring Framework 6.2.19. OSS fix requires Framework 7.0.9 (Boot 4); 6.2.20+ is enterprise-only for this advisory line.
CVE-2026-47890: SSE stream corruption when rendering view fragments. OryxOS SSE (SseWriter / TEXT_EVENT_STREAM) emits structured JSON/text payloads only; no view-fragment rendering over SSE.
CVE-2026-47891: WebFlux Jaxb2XmlDecoder / Aalto maxInMemorySize. OryxOS does not use Spring WebFlux XML decoding (MVC @RestController only).
Remove when upgrading to Spring Boot 4 / Spring Framework 7.0.9+.

CVE-2026-47884 affects XsltView with a /** mapping that renders views without an explicit view name. Official advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/ OryxOS serves static Vue assets and JSON RestControllers, not XsltView/XSLT templates. This is a deployment-specific non-applicability assessment, not a patched Framework. Adding XSLT view resolution invalidates this assessment. Recheck at Framework upgrade or architecture change; see specs/042-workspace-storage/security-triage.md.

CVE-2026-59270: Spring Security embedded UnboundID LDAP (UnboundIdContainer) binds admin DN on all interfaces. OryxOS does not use spring-ldap embedded / UnboundIdContainer (no matches in codebase). Dependency-Check flags spring-security-crypto via CPE.

First-party io.oryxos:oryxos-channel-telegram. Dependency-Check matches the artifact name to cpe:2.3:a:telegram:telegram (the Telegram client/app), not this HTTP Bot API adapter. No Telegram SDK is on the classpath.

First-party io.oryxos:oryxos-channel-whatsapp. Dependency-Check matches the artifact name to cpe:2.3:a:whatsapp:whatsapp (the WhatsApp client), not this Cloud API webhook adapter. No WhatsApp SDK is on the classpath.

First-party io.oryxos:oryxos-channel-mattermost. Dependency-Check matches the artifact name to cpe:2.3:a:mattermost:mattermost (the Mattermost server), not this outgoing-webhook adapter. No Mattermost server/SDK is on the classpath.
First-party io.oryxos:oryxos-channel-teams. Artifact name can CPE-collide with Microsoft Teams client/server products. Adapter talks Bot Framework over HTTP.
First-party io.oryxos:oryxos-channel-gchat. Artifact/name can CPE-collide with Google Chat products. Adapter talks Chat API over HTTP.
First-party io.oryxos:oryxos-channel-matrix. Artifact name can CPE-collide with Matrix homeserver/client products. Adapter talks Client-Server API over HTTP.

CVE-2026-59318: DefaultToolCallingManager may dispatch a tool that was not advertised on the current request. Spring rates it 6.5; NVD scores 9.8, which trips failBuildOnCVSS 8. OSS fix is Spring AI 2.0.1 only; 1.1.9 is enterprise-only (https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59318). OryxOS stays on 1.1.8. Provider sets internalToolExecutionEnabled=false and ToolSchemaAdapter.SchemaOnlyCallback.call always throws; execution is ToolExecutor, not DefaultToolCallingManager. Not introduced by channel governance. Remove when upgrading Spring AI to 2.0.1+.

Component mismatch: this CVE is in npm @opentelemetry/core, not the Java API. https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js/security/advisories/GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf Exact observed Maven versions only; do not suppress unrelated Java advisories.

Component mismatches: generated Java protobuf messages do not contain Go/.NET/C++/JS exporters or propagators. The advisories identify those other implementations, not opentelemetry-proto. Primary evidence by CVE is in specs/042-workspace-storage/security-triage.md. https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-w8rr-5gcm-pp58 https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet/security/advisories/GHSA-38h3-2333-qx47 https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go/security/advisories/GHSA-5wrp-cwcj-q835 https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-cpp/issues/3958 https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js/security/advisories/GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf

Current deployment non-applicability, NOT a claim that Spring AI is patched. 47851 requires the Spring AI PDF outline reader; 47852/59294 require TransformersEmbeddingModel and its ResourceCacheService. These modules are absent from the runtime dependency graph. OryxOS uses its own bounded PDFBox extraction and remote embedding adapters. The unused spring-ai-mcp bridge was removed; only these enumerated AI modules remain. Adding Spring AI PDF readers/ONNX transformers invalidates this exclusion immediately. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47851/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47852/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59294/ 1.1.9 is Enterprise Support Only; OSS fix 2.0.1 needs a separate platform migration.

Current deployment non-applicability, NOT a claim that Framework 6.2.19 is patched. Per-CVE primary advisory links and trigger analysis: specs/042-workspace-storage/security-triage.md. MVC/servlet Tomcat + JSON/static Vue; no reactive server/RSocket, UrlHandlerFilter, UrlFileNameViewController, FreeMarker views, EscapedErrors HTML rendering, untrusted SpEL, or binding to self-populating lists. Simple query scalars and Jackson request bodies do not enable those specific triggers. Adding any of these APIs/configurations invalidates the corresponding exclusion; reviewing library additions alone is insufficient. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59282/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47886/ 6.2.20 is Enterprise Support Only; OSS fix 7.0.9 requires platform migration. Maintainers must reassess before expiry and on endpoint/binding/view/expression changes.

Current deployment non-applicability: Sort.by uses literal lastActiveAt in JpaSessionManager; no controller accepts Sort/Pageable and no untrusted sort expression enters repositories. Fixed-order repository methods and bounded PageRequest paging do not accept property names. Adding client-selectable sort/property strings invalidates this exclusion. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47834/ This does not claim the dependency is patched; upgrade with the supported platform line.

Current deployment non-applicability, NOT a patched Spring Security claim. Only crypto jar is included (no WebAuthn/filter chain/authorization server). PasswordEncoderFactory uses standard DelegatingPasswordEncoder bcrypt, not Password4j. LocalMasterKeyCipher uses JCE AES/GCM with SecureRandom IV, not AesBytesEncryptor/CBC. Adding WebAuthn, DigestAuthenticationFilter, KeyBasedPersistenceTokenService, Password4j, in-memory authorization server or Spring AES encryptors requires immediate reassessment. https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47841/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47842/ https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59276/ 6.5.12 is Enterprise Support Only; OSS fix 7.0.7 requires compatibility assessment.
